summary: The dark RTL interface displays good overall visual fidelity, but exhibits minor layout alignment issues in the sheet actions and crosshair tooltip anchoring.

issues.title: RTL action alignment in modal footer
issues.description: The dialog actions are aligned to the left edge rather than the expected start edge in RTL layout.
issues.evidence: Footer buttons 'تأكيد الشراء' and 'إلغاء' sit at the bottom-left corner of the sheet.
issues.suggestion: Align modal footer actions to the start edge (right) or use a consistent full-width/RTL ordering.

issues.title: Crosshair indicator misaligned with active bar
issues.description: The floating crosshair tag and its guideline do not align accurately with the highlighted chart column.
issues.evidence: The glass tooltip overlay floats centered across multiple bars while the vertical crosshair line sits offset behind it.
issues.suggestion: Snap the crosshair line and tag anchor directly to the selected data bar.
